# `/icons` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### PUT /icons/v1/{objectType}/{objectId}

`setIconV1` — Update an icon — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API endpoint updates an icon by object type and object id. A token with ORG_ADMIN authority is required to call this API.

- Scopes: idn:icons:manage
- Parameters:
  - `objectType` (path, required) — one of application — Object type. Available options ['application']
  - `objectId` (path, required) — Object id.
- Body (multipart/form-data): object
- Returns 200: object

### DELETE /icons/v1/{objectType}/{objectId}

`deleteIconV1` — Delete an icon — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API endpoint delete an icon by object type and object id. A token with ORG_ADMIN authority is required to call this API.

- Scopes: idn:icons:manage
- Parameters:
  - `objectType` (path, required) — one of application — Object type. Available options ['application']
  - `objectId` (path, required) — Object id.
- Returns 204: no body
